decisions.reason: Displaying help text in both the control label and field does not change the existing Danish language or placeholder-content requirements.
The help-text placement decision does not necessarily change the selected field implementation architecture or editable-text mechanism.
The source changes where help text is displayed, not the trigger or behavior for clearing placeholder text when a field is activated.
Showing help text in two locations does not resolve or change the requirement for visual cues identifying editable fields.
Help-text placement does not alter the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
The decision does not change the calendar-dropdown method used by date fields.
The source does not change the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
Caption labels are unrelated to interactive-field control labels and their help-text locations.
The help-text placement decision does not affect the required theme color palette.
The source does not change Enter-key bullet creation behavior.
The help-text placement decision is unrelated to bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source does not affect numbered-list alignment for multi-digit markers.
